scope: Finite independent review of new dashboard/telemetry and supporting original art/reuse stage. No commercial-quality completion gate inferred.

dashboard: Live read-only API and status UI identify measured observation time
Static export identifies snapshot mode and age; no reload-generated fake freshness
Running jobs need process-birth identity or expiring heartbeat
No fabricated percent-complete or paid/provider access
Keyboard filters/pause/refresh/details, narrow and 200-percent layouts, error and empty states
Traversal/symlink rejection and safe rendering of source/job strings
asset: Pinned exact reused inputs with licenses/attribution distinct from commercial game assets
Actual rendered views of current composition, not only installer or code output
Source/runtime promotion boundaries and unresolved art/rig/scale/collision gates explicit
Accepted desktop/mobile counts remain unchanged by tooling/presentation

deployment_observation: Existing Pages workflows replace the single deployment root. Dashboard must compose into retained game site or use downloadable static snapshot; localhost service is not a public always-on host.
